title.narrative: Supporting SEMARNAT in the construction of a Roadmap for the Implementation of Mexico´s Updated NDC

description.narrative: The primary objective of the project is to deliver a robust technical framework to enable a participatory process led by SEMARNAT and contribute to the consolidation of Mexico's updated NDC 3.0 to be presented at COP30 in November 2025.

This project supports the Ministry of Environment and Natural Resources (SEMARNAT) in the development ofanalytical documents outlining in a first phase a technical proposal for Mexico's NDC Implementation Roadmap. The primary objective of this document is to establish a robust technical framework to steer a participatory process led by SEMARNAT, aimed at consolidating Mexico's NDC Implementation Roadmap.In a second phase, a comprehensive analytical document outlining technical inputs to inform Mexico's updated NDC 3.0 is to be carried out. The primary objective of this document is to deliver a robust technical framework to enable a participatory process led by SEMARNAT, aimed at consolidating Mexico's updated NDC 3.0.This technical input has been specifically requested by SEMARNAT to serve as a foundational planning document. It will delineate the current context, needs, opportunities, and challenges, initiating a participatory dialogue. This dialogue will facilitate the prioritization of measures and actions across the territory. Furthermore, it aims to foster partnerships with civil society, international cooperation entities, and the private sector. This will enhance Mexico's climate action efforts.
